nt_type.notes: GABAergic/glycinergic inferred from Slc6a5 (GlyT2) expression in the GLC population (Osorno 2021 preprint) and PC GABAergic synapses onto Lugaro/globular cells (Hirono 2021).

defining_markers.notes: Three-marker GLC logic (Nxph1+, Aldh1a3+, Slc6a5+) from Osorno 2021 preprint; Aldh1a3/Slc6a5 corroborated as putative globular-cell markers by Hirono 2021 review citing Kozareva. Nxph1 is shared with CCs/MLI2/Lugaro, so it is the weakest of the three for discrimination.

Oxtr.notes: Oxtr-Cre targets candelabrum cells, NOT glycinergic globular cells — globular cells are Oxtr-negative by contrast.

morphology.notes: Small rounded soma under PC layer extending into granular layer; long transverse axon spanning microzones; distinct from CC (sagittal ascending axon) and fusiform Lugaro cells.

electrophysiology.notes: Silent at rest; highest-frequency (~50-60 Hz) and largest-amplitude sIPSCs among small granular-layer interneurons; monosynaptic PC-collateral inhibition + likely mossy-fiber excitation; fires to 5-HT and NA; lower input resistance than CCs. All physiology from Hirono 2012 (mouse slice).

anatomical_location.notes: Position at underside of Purkinje cell layer with soma in granular layer — mapped to UBERON:0002979 (PCL) plus coarse UBERON:0002129 (cerebellar cortex) query term. Granular-layer position noted in name_in_source; no dedicated UBERON granular-layer entry added to avoid overstating (soma straddles PCL/granular border).

colocated_types.notes: Purkinje cell (feedback inhibition), Golgi cell (transverse axon target), candelabrum cell (contrast).

cl_mapping.notes: cl_mappings.json returns cl_term_id null for globular_cell_cerebellum after exhaustive OLS4 search. No CL term invented; cl_mapping field omitted from node per instruction. Candidate CL contribution flagged in node notes.
